item.title: ‘To play God’: Cuba’s healthcare system collapses under US pressure

item.title: In Their Own Hands: Ghana’s Drug Vigilantes
item.description: Citizen vigilantes patrol Ghana's streets, fighting an opioid crisis. We meet those taking the law into their own hands.

item.title: Spain’s enclave Ceuta raises alarm as thousands cross border from Morocco
item.description: Estimates suggest up to 2,000 have entered the Spanish territory in recent days in an attempt to reach Europe.
